title: BiasFinder: Metamorphic Test Generation to Uncover Bias for Sentiment Analysis Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Metamorphic testing by generating text mutants where gender-specific words (names, pronouns, and gendered nouns) are substituted in templates, and checking for differences in sentiment analysis predictions.

Metamorphic testing by generating text mutants where occupation words are substituted with 79 different honest, gender-neutral occupation names, and checking for differences in sentiment analysis predictions.

Metamorphic testing by generating text mutants where person names are substituted with names statistically associated with 26 different countries of origin, and checking for differences in sentiment analysis predictions.
